name: python2-leftovers
title: Python 2 leftovers
description: Finds and fixes idioms that only worked in Python 2.
author: example

rules.message: dict.has_key() was removed in Python 3; use `in`
iteritems() was removed in Python 3; use items()
rules.bad:
for k, v in d.iteritems():
    pass
rules.good:
for k, v in d.items():
    pass

rules.message: xrange() does not exist in Python 3; use range()
